title: 3 Questions to Ask Before You Submit Your Resume
description:
You found a role that sounds PERFECT—but before you submit your resume, ask yourself these 3 questions. (They'll help ensure you present the most qualified version of yourself possible.)

00:00 Introduction
00:31 Does each achievement show impact?
01:24 Achievement Assistant tool
01:48 Do your resume achievements have metrics?
03:23 Are you using strong action verbs?
04:13 Before and after

05:12 Wrap-up & conclusion
